a.speaker: Hollis, Spoke & Sprocket
a.text: The bike shop's owner is chaining the rack with a headlamp in his teeth. The headlamp is dead too, so he's using a match. "Card reader's gone. Cash only, if you're buying. Three hundred for the commuter."

options.text: "I'll leave you my watch and my name. I'll pay you double next week."
effects: Pay Hollis double for the bicycle

options.text: Wait until he turns his back and take one off the end of the rack.

sold.speaker: Hollis
sold.text: "Lights won't work. Brakes will." A bicycle covers 40 miles a day; feet cover 15.

no.speaker: Hollis
no.text: "Sorry. Everybody's going to have a story tonight."

stolen.speaker: Spoke & Sprocket
stolen.text: You walk it into the dark, then ride. Nobody shouts. That's the worst part.

caught.speaker: Hollis
caught.text: "Hey!" He gets a hand on the seat. You let go. Nobody says anything else, but three people saw it. (Profile +2.)

done.speaker: Spoke & Sprocket
done.text: The rack is chained and the shop is dark.
